note: BLUEPRINT_v2 E4-2: the aggregate trading houses. Foreign prices: World Bank Commodity Price Data (Pink Sheet) 2024 annual averages (public domain); FX: BoJ 2024 average; freight: T; tariffs: 関税定率法 / 関税暫定措置法 (S); foreign capacity: T from world export volumes (USDA PSD) as a monthly share available to Japan; lead 1 month (T). want = last month's unmet domestic demand (T); start_in_transit_t = the first month's arrival, the published import flow / 12 (D). state_trading: true = the state imports the gap up to the quota regardless of the private margin (wheat, MA rice).

fx_jpy_usd.label: D
fx_jpy_usd.source: BoJ FM08 FXERD04, US.Dollar/Yen Spot Rate at 17:00 JST, Tokyo Market, 2024-12-30 (the last in-window business day): the level held from 2025-01 (the PM, TO_E 20:01; researcher4's raw file)

rice.label: S/T
rice.source: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly, "Rice, Thai 5%" ($/mt), 2024M11; CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly.xlsx sheet Monthly Prices; published 2024-12-03 (2024-11, the last in-window month)
rice.start_in_transit_source: MA rice is the state's, not the trading houses'

wheat.label: S/T
wheat.source: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly, "Wheat, US HRW" ($/mt), 2024M11; CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly.xlsx sheet Monthly Prices; published 2024-12-03 (2024-11, the last in-window month)
wheat.start_in_transit_source: MAFF 食料需給表 令和5年度 小麦 輸入 約5.0 Mt/yr / 12 (D)

soybeans.label: S/T
soybeans.source: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly, "Soybeans" ($/mt), 2024M11; CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly.xlsx sheet Monthly Prices; published 2024-12-03 (2024-11, the last in-window month)
soybeans.start_in_transit_source: D: the model's own month-0 import need (the start rule; the PM's ruling on TO_PM 126): food manufacturing's bid at capacity 2424.9 bn (247188 t) + the held final demand (37123 t) - the crop / 12 (21787 t); tools/modern/start_flows.py. It replaces the published import flow, which ran above this need (M038)
soybeans.imports_source: S: 財務省 貿易統計 2023暦年 確定 大豆 輸入 3,155,521 t (published 2024-11-13; R96c group B, the CIF unit value's denominator)

vegetables.label: T
vegetables.source: T: fresh and frozen vegetables, average import unit value ~$0.9/kg (customs 2024, D); tariff ~3% treated as 0 (T); capacity T (imports ~2.7 Mt/yr)
vegetables.start_in_transit_source: D: the model's own month-0 import need (the start rule; the PM's ruling on TO_PM 126): food manufacturing's bid at capacity 2424.9 bn (307095 t) + the held final demand (850540 t) - the crop / 12 (916617 t); tools/modern/start_flows.py.
